products.name: Nutella Gulstha
products.tagline: Rich Nutella Cream Swirl with Toasted Nuts
products.description: Velvety sweet dairy cream marbled with luscious Italian Nutella cocoa-hazelnut spread and crowned with crunchy roasted almonds.
products.servingSuggestion: Chilled at 4°C. Perfect dessert after lunch or dinner.
products.pairingNotes: Arabic coffee or cold brewed iced mocha.

products.name: Pistachio Lotus Gulstha
products.tagline: Pure Pistachio Mousse paired with Biscoff Crunch
products.description: Dual layer perfection combining crushed spiced Lotus Biscoff biscuit crust with aromatic Mediterranean pistachio velvet cream.
products.servingSuggestion: Scoop both layers together for the authentic texture contrast.
products.pairingNotes: Cardamom black tea or specialty cappuccino.

products.name: Nutella Pistachio Gulstha
products.tagline: Decadent Nutella Hazelnut & Emerald Pistachio Harmony
products.description: A harmonious indulgence uniting dark chocolate Nutella ganache and pure roasted pistachio cream, topped with hand-crushed nuts.
products.servingSuggestion: Allow to sit at room temperature for 2 minutes to soften slightly.
products.pairingNotes: Espresso or hot steamed milk.

products.name: Nutella Salankatia
products.tagline: Signature Rich Nutella Fudge & Sweet Laban Cream
products.description: Sky Laban’s celebrated Salankatia recipe featuring thick ribbons of Nutella layered with slow-churned cultured milk cream and hazelnut crunch.
products.servingSuggestion: Keep refrigerated until served. Enjoy with a dessert spoon.
products.pairingNotes: Warm Karak chai or Turkish coffee.

products.name: Pistachio Lotus Salankatia
products.tagline: Artisanal Green Pistachio & Spiced Lotus Crunch
products.description: The iconic half-and-half masterpiece: sweet pistachio cream on one side and golden spiced Lotus biscuit crumb on the other.
products.servingSuggestion: Best served straight from the chilled tub.
products.pairingNotes: Moroccan mint tea or espresso macchiato.

products.name: Nutella Lotus Salankatia
products.tagline: Warm Cocoa Hazelnut & Spiced Biscoff Fusion
products.description: Two legendary dessert flavors together in our signature Salankatia tub — rich Nutella cocoa fudge and caramelized Belgian Biscoff cream.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled in family bowls.
products.pairingNotes: Iced vanilla latte or fresh pour-over coffee.

products.name: Lotus Koushiri
products.tagline: Layered Egyptian Dessert with Crunchy Biscoff Pearls
products.description: Authentic Egyptian sweet Koushiri reimagined with velvety cream layers, crisp golden toasted pastry filaments, and caramelized Lotus biscuit sauce.
products.servingSuggestion: Enjoy slowly from bottom to top to experience all textural layers.
products.pairingNotes: Fresh mint infusion or iced cardamom tea.

products.name: Pistachio Koushiri
products.tagline: Roasted Green Pistachio Cream with Crisp Pastry
products.description: Crisp layered pastry noodles enveloped in pure pistachio cream sauce, crowned with whole emerald pistachios and sweet clotted dairy.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled at afternoon tea.
products.pairingNotes: Arabic saffron tea or chilled laban.

products.name: Nutella Hazelnut Koushiri
products.tagline: Decadent Chocolate Ganache with Toasted Pastry
products.description: Golden crunchy dessert pasta tossed with dark Nutella cocoa sauce, sweet condensed milk cream, and roasted crunchy hazelnut nibs.
products.servingSuggestion: Best paired with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
products.pairingNotes: Dark roast espresso or Americano.

products.name: Nutella Ruh Hayati
products.tagline: “Soul of My Life” Nutella Cream Dream
products.description: A poetic Middle Eastern dessert blending delicate clotted laban mousse with deep hazelnut Nutella swirl and honeyed nut brittle.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled in crystal coupe glasses.
products.pairingNotes: Earl Grey tea or Turkish coffee.

products.name: Pistachio Ruh Hayati
products.tagline: Luxurious Pure Pistachio Mousse Delight
products.description: Slow-churned velvet pistachio mousse folded with white chocolate laban ganache, garnished with freshly roasted Iranian pistachios.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled with fresh mint leaf garnish.
products.pairingNotes: Cardamom Karak chai.

products.name: Nutella Lotus Ruh Hayati
products.tagline: Harmonious Trio of Nutella, Lotus & Sweet Cream
products.description: An extraordinary union of rich hazelnut cocoa, spiced Belgian biscuit spread, and our velvety cultured farm dairy cream.
products.servingSuggestion: Scoop through all three layers for the ultimate treat.
products.pairingNotes: Hot latte or single-origin pour over.

products.name: Nutella Lou'a
products.tagline: Fluffy Sweet Dumplings Glazed with Nutella
products.description: Traditional golden fried dessert bites crisp on the exterior and airy inside, generously drenched in warm Nutella ganache.
products.servingSuggestion: Enjoy freshly prepared with family.
products.pairingNotes: Arabic coffee or black tea with sage.

products.name: Pistachio Lotus Lou'a
products.tagline: Crisp Dessert Bites Drizzled with Pistachio & Biscoff
products.description: Golden dessert bites glazed with duo sauces — stone-ground pistachio drizzle and caramelized Lotus Biscoff butter.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed warm alongside fresh milk tea.
products.pairingNotes: Masala chai or cardamom brew.

products.name: Kinder Lou'a
products.tagline: Glazed with Creamy Italian White & Milk Chocolate
products.description: Crisp golden lou’a bites smothered in authentic Kinder Bueno hazelnut cream and melted milk chocolate ribbon.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve warm immediately after drizzling.
products.pairingNotes: Chilled whole milk or hot chocolate.

products.name: Pistachio Belgium Chocolate Hiba Cake
products.tagline: Sponge Cake Layered with Pistachio Cream & Belgian Ganache
products.description: Delicate vanilla chiffon cake soaked in sweet laban milk, filled with Bronte pistachio mousse and frosted with Belgian dark chocolate fudge.
products.servingSuggestion: Slice cold with a warm knife for pristine layers.
products.pairingNotes: Double espresso or Earl Grey black tea.

products.name: Pistachio Kinder Chocolate Hiba Cake
products.tagline: Layered Sponge with Kinder Cream & Emerald Pistachios
products.description: Rich layers of moist sponge filled with Italian Kinder hazelnut cream, smothered with crushed green pistachios and white chocolate curls.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled for celebrations and family gatherings.
products.pairingNotes: Cappuccino or iced cold brew.

products.name: Faza Pistachio Cake
products.tagline: Decadent Pistachio Sponge with Velvety Dairy Frosting
products.description: Signature Faza dessert cake made with finely ground roasted pistachios, soaked in cardamom milk, and frosted with whipped cream cheese laban.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve slightly chilled.
products.pairingNotes: Karak tea or French press coffee.

products.name: Faza Chocolate Cake
products.tagline: Intense Dark Belgian Fudge Cake with Cocoa Glaze
products.description: Deep cocoa sponge infused with rich chocolate fudge syrup, covered in glossy Belgian chocolate glaze and topped with shaved truffles.
products.servingSuggestion: Warm slightly for 15 seconds to enjoy a molten center.
products.pairingNotes: Cold whole milk or single-origin espresso.

products.name: Kunafa Pastry
products.tagline: Crispy Golden Kataifi Strands with Clotted Cream Heart
products.description: Buttery kataifi pastry baked until golden and crispy, filled with fresh clotted ashta cream and soaked in fragrant orange blossom syrup.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve warm right from the oven with crushed pistachios on top.
products.pairingNotes: Black Ceylon tea or Arabic Qahwa.

products.name: Dubai Kunafa Chocolate
products.tagline: Viral Dubai Chocolate Bar with Pistachio Kataifi Crunch
products.description: Thick Belgian milk chocolate shell loaded with crunchy butter-toasted kataifi pastry filaments, premium pistachio butter, and tahini.
products.servingSuggestion: Snap in half to reveal the vibrant emerald crunchy center.
products.pairingNotes: Hot black coffee or unsweetened iced tea.

products.name: Kabsa
products.tagline: Traditional Sweet Rice Dessert with Nuts & Saffron Cream
products.description: Our sweet dessert interpretation of royal Kabsa — fragrant sweet basmati simmered in saffron milk cream, garnished with golden raisins, cashews, and silver varq.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve warm in traditional brass bowls.
products.pairingNotes: Saffron tea or warm water.

products.name: Aseera Pistachio
products.tagline: Rich Drinkable Pistachio Cream Nectar in Glass Bottle
products.description: Sky Laban’s signature drinkable dessert: thick, chilled sweet cultured laban blended with 100% stone-ground pistachio paste.
products.servingSuggestion: Shake well and drink cold straight from the bottle.
products.pairingNotes: Warm brioche bun or tea cookies.

products.name: Aseera Lotus
products.tagline: Chilled Drinkable Spiced Biscoff Cream Nectar
products.description: Creamy cold laban nectar blended with melted Belgian Biscoff spread and crushed spiced biscuit crumbs for a soothing treat on the go.
products.servingSuggestion: Shake thoroughly before opening. Keep at 2°C.
products.pairingNotes: Fresh pastries or morning croissants.

products.name: Aseera Mango
products.tagline: Fresh Tropical Alphonso Mango Cream Nectar
products.description: Luscious tropical dessert drink made with ripe Alphonso mango pulp churned into fresh sweet cultured laban cream.
products.servingSuggestion: Shake well and drink ice cold.
products.pairingNotes: Fresh mint or butter cookies.

products.name: Aseera Nutella
products.tagline: Drinkable Cocoa Hazelnut Cream Nectar
products.description: Chilled drinkable dessert combining Italian Nutella cocoa-hazelnut spread with creamy dairy nectar in a grab-and-go glass bottle.
products.servingSuggestion: Keep refrigerated at 2°C. Shake vigorously before opening.
products.pairingNotes: Fresh waffles or warm churros.

products.name: Bomb Dessert
products.tagline: Exploding Chocolate Sphere with Hot Ganache Pour
products.description: A theatrical chocolate dome filled with brownie bites, pistachio mousse, and vanilla gelato that melts open as piping hot Belgian chocolate is poured tableside.
products.servingSuggestion: Pour the hot chocolate sauce evenly over the sphere at the table.
products.pairingNotes: Specialty double shot espresso.

products.name: Sheer Khurma
products.tagline: Royal Eid Vermicelli Pudding with Dates & Dry Fruits
products.description: Slow-simmered whole milk pudding loaded with roasted fine vermicelli, Medjool dates, chironji, pistachios, almonds, and aromatic green cardamom.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve warm or chilled according to your family tradition.
products.pairingNotes: Karak tea or black coffee.

products.name: Kashmira
products.tagline: Royal Kashmiri Saffron & Walnuts with Clotted Cream
products.description: Rich cultured cream infused with authentic Kashmiri saffron threads, wildflower honey, and roasted Kashmiri mountain walnuts.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve chilled in porcelain dessert bowls.
products.pairingNotes: Kashmiri Kahwa tea with green cardamom.

products.name: De Paris Box
products.tagline: Luxury Assorted Dessert Presentation Gift Box
products.description: An elegant branded sky-blue presentation box with ribbon detailing, containing an assortment of Sky Laban’s finest mini creations for gifting.
products.servingSuggestion: Keep refrigerated until gifting or serving.
products.pairingNotes: Celebration drinks, coffees, and teas.

content.franchiseSubheadline: Join our fast-growing dessert brand and bring world-class creamy experiences, iconic packaging, and loyal customers to your territory.
content.reelsSubtext: Discover our latest creations, behind-the-scenes moments and the sweet experiences of Sky Laban.
content.ourStoryJourney: Alhamdulillah, from our first store in Shaikpet in April 2026, Sky Laban has grown into a family of 15 outlets. Every location reflects our commitment to quality, consistency, and sharing moments of pure delight with our customers.

settings.metaTitle: Sky Laban — Artisanal Desserts, Salankatia & Egyptian Delights
settings.metaDescription: Indulge in authentic Salankatia, Koushiri, Hiba Cakes and artisanal dairy desserts crafted with Bronte pistachios and Belgian chocolate.

founders.name: B. Akram Ali Khan
founders.title: Founder & Chief Visionary
founders.description: With a deep passion for premium desserts and a vision to create a brand that brings people together, B. Akram Ali Khan laid the foundation of Sky Laban. His commitment to quality, innovation, and customer happiness continues to guide the brand’s journey from our first outlet in Shaikpet to 15 outlets across Hyderabad and beyond.

founders.name: B. Aslam Ali Khan
founders.title: Co-Founder & Operations Leader
founders.description: B. Aslam Ali Khan drives the operational excellence behind Sky Laban, ensuring consistent quality, great taste, and a delightful experience at every outlet. His dedication, hands-on approach, and strong focus on people and processes have been key to the brand’s growth and success.
